title: Watercolor "Blessings by the Sea" 160 E Royal Fern Way
h1: Watercolor "Blessings by the Sea" 160 E Royal Fern Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- 6 Seater Electric Cart- 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Private Pool with sitting Spa (Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $35 per day.)- Parking for 2 Vehicles- Natural Gas Grill- Exterior Shower- Located in the Heart of WaterColor's Crossing District- 1.6 miles to Watercolor Beach Club Access- 1.2 miles to Seaside- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Located in the Crossing District at 160 East Royal Fern Way, "Blessings by the Sea" encompasses a fresh and relaxing ambiance from the soothing neutral tones and chic designer finishes throughout. From the moment you walk inside, you will be enthralled by the beauty of this home as the open-concept floor plan allows a great flow for guests to enjoy the kitchen, dining, and living room area. Custom bright white cabinetry, quartz countertops, premium stainless-steel appliances, and plenty of seating options make this kitchen a dreamy place for entertaining. A gorgeous first-floor primary suite offers a king bed and a private bathroom with marble finishes, a glass shower, a separate soaking tub, and a large walk-in closet. On this main level, there is also a half bathroom and laundry room with a convenient space in the adjacent mud room for keeping your beach gear during your stay.Moving up the stairwell, the second floor features a secondary living space with a flat-screen TV creating the ideal setup for kids or teens to enjoy a space of their own in addition to three beautiful rooms on this level and a second half bathroom. The first bedroom features a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower and tub combination. The second king bed guest room offers access to the shared bathroom with a shower and tub combination as does the third bedroom that hosts two built-in twin-over-twin bunk beds.This beautiful home offers a screened-in porch with plenty of seating for dining al fresco or the ideal space to savor a slow start to the morning with coffee on the shaded front porch. Guests can enjoy a breezy ride on one of the home's four cruiser bikes or take the 6-seater electric cart for a spin– both of which are perfect for exploring the beautiful scenery of WaterColor and the 30A area. This home's convenient location is just minutes from Publix as well as some of the best local dining, shopping, and entertainment along 30A. In addition to access provided to all Watercolor community pools including Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club with your stay, “Blessings by the Sea” will also feature its own private pool for guests to enjoy as this home offers all you could want in your next perfect 30A getaway. Let us help you create lasting memories of time spent with those you love and start planning your next stay today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunkbeds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

This home's convenient location is just minutes from Publix as well as some of the best local dining, shopping, and entertainment along 30A. In addition to access provided to all Watercolor community pools including Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club with your stay, “Blessings by the Sea” will also feature its own private pool for guests to enjoy as this home offers all you could want in your next perfect 30A getaway.
